title: Tidy src/FsAnalyser.App: HF-002, HF-004, HF-007, HF-012, HF-018, HF-019, HF-020
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: HF-019 was never run on a real second monitor, and not with mixed DPI, because this PC has one 1920x1080 monitor at 100%. A person with a monitor arranged below the primary should launch the published exe once and confirm it stays on that monitor.

The delete-first step deletes whatever file is at the --report path, and now read-only files too. Nothing restricts it to a report file (the HF-018 finding noted this). A person may want it to refuse to delete a file that is not a schema-1 report.

WindowReport's 'topLevel' section counts Unreadable rows but not how many of them were ListedPartway. A later slice could add a key if a check needs to tell them apart. Schema-1 keys are only ever added.

RefreshTopLevel could ignore final snapshots, leaving them to the ending, to close the tick race described in deviations. That would need SL-063's TheResultsListShowsTheMarkOnATickAndAtTheEnding reworked.
